notes.title: All three chapters of Tell Me Why FREE for June 2021!
notes.content:
This Pride Month, we’re making all three chapters of Tell Me Why free on all of our available platforms!

From June 1, 2021 through June 30, 2021, downloading Tell Me Why will give you permanent access to the award-winning narrative adventure from DONTNOD Entertainment and Xbox Game Studios Publishing, even after Pride Month is over.

In making Tell Me Why free for June 2021, we hope to allow even more people to access the game, and to encourage our players to spend their money in places that will directly affect trans and queer communities. For more info on how you can help us support these goals, check out our [url=https://www.tellmewhygame.com/pride-month-2021/]blog post[/url]!

notes.title: Life is Strange dev's acclaimed supernatural mystery thriller Tell Me Why is currently free
notes.content:
All three episodes of Life is Strange developer Dontnod's well-received supernatural mystery adventure Tell Me Why are currently free on PC and Xbox.

Tell Me Why, if you're unfamiliar, tells the story of twins Tyler and Alyson as they reunite, after several years apart, to sell their childhood home in the picturesque Alaskan town of Delos Crossing - a task that ultimately forces them to confront their traumatic past.

What follows is a deft blend of supernatural mystery thriller and earnest, character-driven homecoming drama - there's real beauty and warmth in the relationship between its twin protagonists - that's arguably Dontnod's most assured, consistently enjoyable outing yet, even if its perhaps not quite as devastatingly memorable as its Life is Strange forebears.

notes.title: Chapter 1 of Tell Me Why now available for free!
notes.content:
It's easier than ever to dive into the story of the Ronan twins' homecoming. [b]That's right: Chapter 1 of Tell Me Why is now free across all platforms![/b]

Now you can experience the first part of this award-winning, best-in-class narrative adventure from DONTNOD Entertainment and Xbox Game Studios at no cost - and if you enjoy the first chapter, the rest of the game is now more affordable than ever.

With Chapter 1 of Tell Me Why now available for free, we encourage new players to visit [url=https://www.tellmewhygame.com/faq/]the FAQ on our website[/url]. This page provides details(occasionally with spoilers!) around depictions of transphobia, misgendering and other topics in the game.

Thanks to all who have accompanied the twins on their journey. We hope to see you in Delos Crossing soon!

notes.title: Tell Me Why wins at The Game Awards 2020!
notes.content:
[b]Tell Me Why has won in the Games for Impact category[/b] at The Game Awards 2020!

Our team at DONTNOD Entertainment and Xbox Publishing could not be more humbled to accept this award - and we'd like to express our deep admiration for all of this year's nominees, especially those that have used their platform tell trans and queer stories with sincerity and heart.

[b]Thank you so much to all of you who have joined Tyler and Alyson on their journey! This award would not have been possible without each and every one of our players and fans.[/b]

To see the moment Gal Gadot announced the winner of the Games for Impact award, watch below!

notes.title: Additional voiceover languages now available!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to share that voiceover for Tell Me Why is now available in the following languages:
[list]
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Spanish (Latin America)
[*] Portuguese (Brazil)
[/list]

Subtitles remain available in the above languages, as well as in Italian, Japanese and Korean.

If you don't see these languages in the game right away, you may need to download the latest version update.

Voiceover in the above languages was intended to be included with the game at launch; however, the COVID-19 pandemic made it very difficult - and in many cases impossible - to safely record our voice actors. We greatly appreciate your patience, and we hope you continue to enjoy the Ronan twins' journey!

This addition marks the last update to language availability for Tell Me Why. Unfortunately, we do not anticipate localization support for additional languages at this time.

What do you think of the new voiceover? Let us know!

notes.title: All chapters of Tell Me Why now available!
notes.content:
We hope you've been enjoying Tell Me Why, the latest narrative adventure from DONTNOD Entertainment and Xbox Game Studios.

Today marks the launch of Chapter 3, the final installment of the Ronan twins' story - meaning that the whole Tell Me Why experience is now available! If you've been waiting to play all chapters of Tell Me Why at once, there's never been a better time to dive in than now.

Tell Me Why features multiple endings, and the choices the player makes throughout all three chapters will affect the twins’ homecoming. Will you guide the Ronans toward closure or catastrophe?

Chapter 3 may be the end of Tyler's and Alyson's homecoming, but there’s always more secrets to uncover! If you’d like to chat about the choices you made throughout the game or compare observations with other fans, our Steam community is always open! You might also consider joining the official Tell Me Why [url=https://discord.com/invite/tellmewhy]Discord[/url] channel, or following us on other social media, including [url=https://twitter.com/tellmewhygame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://instagram.com/tellmewhygame]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://facebook.com/tellmewhygame]Facebook[/url].

Thanks for all of your support so far - and we hope to see you in Delos Crossing again soon!

notes.title: Tell Me Why review
notes.content:
Tell Me Why review
The pacing makes this one a very slow burn, but Tell Me Why is a good entry into Dontnod’s library of stories about families and sad magic.

  • Developer: Dontnod Entertainment
  • Publisher: Xbox Game Studios
  • Release: Out now
  • On: Windows
  • From: Steam
  • Price: £25/€30/$30

If you’ve played Life Is Strange or Life Is Strange 2, you probably know roughly what to expect from Dontnod’s new story-focused adventure about about small towns and intense familial relationships, Tell Me Why. However, whereas LIS focused more on the teen experience of these themes, Tell My Why feels more like it’s been made for grown-ups – or at least us as grown-ups and not the teenagers within us. Not because it’s more sweary or any darker than LIS, but because the protagonists are adults dealing with adult problems.

In fairness, these problems are ones mostly rooted in their childhood. The Ronan twins are returning to their old home in Alaska for the first time in an actual decade after a fairly traumatic event one night that led to their separation. Alyson has been living in their home town in the intervening years, but Tyler hasn’t even been back. By using their twin-bility to share sparkly ghost visions of past events, the Ronans begin to unpick what actually happened on that fateful night (which was dark and stormy, as well).
